def read_input():
    return map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())

def calculate_square_vertices(x1, y1, x2, y2):
    dx = x2 - x1
    dy = y2 - y1
    
    # Calculate potential third vertex (clockwise)
    x3_cw = x2 + dy
    y3_cw = y2 - dx
    
    # Calculate potential fourth vertex (clockwise)
    x4_cw = x1 + dy
    y4_cw = y1 - dx
    
    # Calculate potential third vertex (counter-clockwise)
    x3_ccw = x2 - dy
    y3_ccw = y2 + dx
    
    # Calculate potential fourth vertex (counter-clockwise)
    x4_ccw = x1 - dy
    y4_ccw = y1 + dx
    
    # Function to check if three points are in counter-clockwise order
    def is_counter_clockwise(p1, p2, p3):
        return (p2[0] - p1[0]) * (p3[1] - p1[1]) > (p2[1] - p1[1]) * (p3[0] - p1[0])
    
    # Check which set of vertices forms a counter-clockwise square
    if is_counter_clockwise((x1, y1), (x2, y2), (x3_cw, y3_cw)) and is_counter_clockwise((x2, y2), (x3_cw, y3_cw), (x4_cw, y4_cw)):
        return x3_cw, y3_cw, x4_cw, y4_cw
    elif is_counter_clockwise((x1, y1), (x2, y2), (x3_ccw, y3_ccw)) and is_counter_clockwise((x2, y2), (x3_ccw, y3_ccw), (x4_ccw, y4_ccw)):
        return x3_ccw, y3_ccw, x4_ccw, y4_ccw
    else:
        raise ValueError("No valid counter-clockwise square found")
